title: Wiki Codex Manual
summary: Navigate articles, collections, guide books, related links, filters, and optional addon records.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Wiki is the player-facing Codex. It blends authored articles with live world and addon records so available modules can appear when they are loaded.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Use the Overview for status, Articles for written guidance, Guide Books for physical manuals, and dynamic pages for regions, hazards, machines, missions, and factions.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Search or filter, open an article, follow related records, and use guide books as stable module-specific entry points.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Articles and collections provide written guidance. Guide books are physical manuals. Related links can bridge into Index when the needed addon is present.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Optional visual styling, Terminal links, Index records, and TutorialCore progress make the Codex more useful when those addons are loaded.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a manual or article is missing, check load warnings on the debug page and verify the optional addon required by that guide book is loaded.
